decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit the firm's dental materials and lab-workflow business well, and although four years should have revealed demand, the line is still a relatively low-cost option worth retaining unless performance clearly disappoints.

The PETG thermoforming blank is closely adjacent to the firm's established materials offering, so despite reduced uncertainty by 2022 it remains a sensible option to keep because it likely shares channels, capabilities, and support costs with the core portfolio.

A UV-curing lacquer is a peripheral accessory that was only weakly featured from the start, and by 2022 the option value is likely largely exhausted, making resource reallocation more attractive than continued support.

Custom earmolds are strongly aligned with the firm's hearing-care competencies, specialist channels, and custom manufacturing base, so this product line remains strategically coherent enough to keep on the market.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are a narrower niche than standard earmolds, but they still leverage the same production know-how and channels, so the firm would likely keep them unless demand falls clearly below expectations.
